summary.headline: Strength of Electional Indicators
summary.text: Discussion of electional astrology, explaining how the relative strength of fortunate and unfortunate indicators in the radical and revolution ascendants determines whether an elected time produces complete, limited, or no additional felicity. Ptolemy’s Centiloquium and al-Tusi’s commentary are cited as authorities.
